extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, classification clerks, patent attorneys, and patent searchers needing technology-class taxonomy
extracted.subtask_description: A technology-classification listing (classes and subclasses) used to categorize mechanical, photographic, optical and musical-instrument related patent documents. Each entry names a class/subclass and gives the kinds of machines or articles placed in that class.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 15-05 (CONT.) - cleaning, drying, laundry and related machines
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists cleaning and laundry machines: e.g., carpet beating vacuum cleaners; vacuum cleaners (industrial or domestic); filling indicators for vacuum cleaners; washing machines; washing machines (observation panels for -); washing machines for laundry purposes; dryers (for wood shavings); drying cabinets; centrifugal drying machines; driers for laundry purposes; dishwashers; ironing machines; ironers; mangles; mangling and ironing machines; accessories such as dish racks for dishwashers; hublots of washing machines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides many concrete examples/terms to determine class membership (e.g., 'VACUUM CLEANERS (CARPET BEATING)', 'WASHING MACHINES (OBSERVATION PANELS FOR -)', 'DRYING CABINETS', 'IRONING MACHINES', 'DISHWASHERS (MACHINES)'). Includes French equivalents and related index terms for cross-reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 15-06 (CONT.) - textile, sewing, knitting and embroidering machines
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers textile machinery and parts: balling machines; battens for looms; bobbins (spinning); braiding machines (textile); buttonhole machines; calenders (roll -) (textile); combs for weaving; cutting up cloth into patterns (machines for -); darning machines; dobby for weaving looms; embroidery frames and perforators; fabric stretching frames; hemming machines; hosiery looms; humidifiers (thread -) (spinning); knitting looms; loom components (shuttle guides, quills, spindles); sewing machine shuttles, tables, treadles; reels for textile machines; spinning frames and spindles; warp/warping machines; weaving looms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerates both complete machines and machine parts (e.g., 'SPINDLES FOR SPINNING (MACHINE PARTS)', 'TABLES (SEWING MACHINE-)'). Useful to decide whether an invention relates to whole textile machines vs parts/accessories.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 15-08 - machines for preparing food and drink (food industry machines)
rubrics_metrics.description: Food- and drink-preparation machinery: beer wort apparatus; biscuit presses; bread molds; butchers' machines; butter churns (machines); centrifugal milk separators; churning machines; cleaning malt machines; coffee roasters; corers (apple -) industrial; cream separating apparatus; crushers (oil cake); grape crushing machines; cutting and gutting fish machines; dough cutting and mixing machines; industrial fruit-juice extractors; flour milling machines and sieves; chilling/cooling/refrigerating apparatus; distilling stills for alcoholic liquors; presses (fruit or vegetable; oil; wine), molds for bread, pastry and confectionery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists specific industrial food-processing equipment and parts (e.g., 'FRUIT-JUICE EXTRACTORS (INDUSTRIAL)', 'MIXING MACHINES (DOUGH-)'). Helpful to classify inventions aimed at food-processing, dairy, bakery, beverage and related machinery.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 15-09 - material working, abrading and founding machinery
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers machines for material working and metal/stone working: abrading machines; grinding and sharpening (machines for sharpening, trueing, dressing); band saws; barrel boring/drilling machines; pipe benders; bending brakes; bevelling/chamfering machines; boring machines (except for rocks); brakes (bending-); brick and tile molding machines; calendering machines (paper and other); casting/carriage machines; casting machines and molding machines; drilling/percer machines (except rocks); forging presses; grinding and crushing machines (industrial); hydraulic presses; lathes (machine tools); milling machines; rolling mills for metal; sawing machines; sandblast machines; sharpening machines; welding machines; various machine tools and toolroom equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes both heavy industrial machinery and machine tools; enumerates exceptions (e.g., 'BORING MACHINES (EXCEPT FOR ROCKS)') and related apparatus (control desks for machine tools, loading apparatus for blast furnaces). Use these keywords/examples to determine class membership for metal/stone working inventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 15-99 (CONT.) - miscellaneous machinery and machinery parts
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous machines not elsewhere classified: bag/sack filling machines; balancing machines for vehicle wheels; ball bearings; belting machines; driving belts; boilers for vulcanization; apparatus for boring the ground; bottle-capping machines; machines for drawing and filling bottles; corking/capsuling machines; cigarette-making machines; tyre/tire-fitting and removing apparatus; jigs for repairing vehicle bodies; handling of radioactive material (machines for mechanical handling); packing/packing presses and machines; separators for grease/waste water; wheel balancing; winding machines (mining); many other diverse machines and machine parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Function-based catch-all section; examples show where to place inventions that don't fit main mechanical subclasses (e.g., 'BOTTLE-CAPPING MACHINES', 'HANDLING OF RADIOACTIVE MATERIAL (MACHINES FOR MECHANICAL-)').

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 16 - photographic, cinematographic and optical apparatus (overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level class grouping photographic, cinematographic and other optical apparatus and articles, including cameras, projectors, photocopying and enlarging apparatus, developing apparatus and equipment, accessories, and optical articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as umbrella for several numbered subclasses (01–06) that enumerate cameras, projectors, developing equipment, accessories and optical articles; useful for classifying imaging- and optics-related patent filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 16-01 - photographic cameras and film cameras (including cinematographic cameras)
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers photographic and cinematographic cameras and related components: camera shutters; cinematographic cameras; diaphragms (iris) for photography; film cameras; filming apparatus; photographic cameras; shutters (camera-).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes both photographic still and motion-picture cameras and key parts (shutters, diaphragms). French/alternate terms appear in the index for cross-reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 16-02 - projectors and projection apparatus
rubrics_metrics.description: Projection apparatus and related devices: diaprojection apparatus; film or slide projectors; viewers for films or slides; projection apparatus (cinematographic and diapositives); slide or film projectors; viewers for slides or films; projection apparatus examples include projectors (slide or film-), viewers, and related accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists devices for viewing/projecting images (film/slide); cross-references to viewers and projectors and indicates related items such as screens and projector spools.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 16-03 - photocopying apparatus and enlargers (printing and facsimile equipment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Photocopying and enlarging equipment: photographic enlargers; facsimile machines; blueprint lamps and printing machines (blueprint-); microfilm reading and microfilming apparatus; photographic enlargers and easels for enlarging; printers (photography); reading apparatus (microfilm-).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes devices for reproducing/printing photographic images or plans and for microfilm/facsimile processing; examples help classify printing/enlargement-related inventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 16-04 - developing apparatus and equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: Film and photographic developing equipment: developing baths (containers) for photography; developing tanks for films; apparatus and implements for developing films; photographic prints developing equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies containers and apparatus used in photographic developing processes (e.g., 'BATHS (DEVELOPING - (CONTAINERS) FOR PHOTOGRAPHY)'), useful for process/apparatus patents in photo development.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 16-05 - accessories for photographic and cinematographic apparatus
rubrics_metrics.description: Accessories and consumables: cardboard frames for photographs; film cassettes (including for microfilms); projection remote controls; mounting corners for photographs; diapositives loaders; exposure meters; tables (photography); film loaders; film cassettes and chargers; tripods and stands; film spools and reels; shutter releases; masks for printing (photography); holders and frames for slides/diapositives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extensive listing of accessories (mechanical and optical) and small parts; use to classify peripheral devices, consumables and mounting/handling accessories associated with cameras, projectors and film.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 16-06 - optical articles (lenses, spectacles, microscopes, optical instruments)
rubrics_metrics.description: Optical articles excluding photographic/cinematographic items: anti-dazzle spectacles; binoculars; eyeglasses and frames (including pince-nez, lorgnettes); field glasses; opera glasses; magnifying glasses and objectives; microscopes (including electronic microscopes); optical mirrors and periscopes; eye-glasses frames and parts; spy-holes and door-viewers; optical instruments and accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers a broad range of eyewear and optical instruments with many specific examples (e.g., 'MICROSCOPES', 'LUNETTES (OPTIQUE)', 'TELESCOPES'). Includes parts (hinges, bridges) and special-purpose optical items.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 17 - musical instruments (overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level class grouping musical instruments, organized into subclasses for keyboard, wind, stringed and percussion instruments and their parts/accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acts as umbrella for subclasses 01–04 which enumerate instrument families and components; useful for classifying musical-instrument related patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 17-01 - keyboard instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Keyboard family: accordions, concertinas, harmoniums, pianos (mechanical, sound-boards), organs (including electronic organs), keys (piano-), mechanical pianos, piano pedals, sound boards, stops (organ-), organ pipes and registers; general term 'keyboard instruments'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes both acoustic and electronic keyboard instruments and components (keys, pedals, stops), enabling classification of improvements to pianos, organs and similar devices.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 17-02 - wind instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Wind instruments: bagpipes, bassoons, bugles, clarinets, cornets, euphoniums, flutes, harmonicas, horns (bass hunting and musical), kazoos, mouth organs, oboes, ocarinas, piccolos, reeds for musical instruments, saxophones, trombones, trumpets, and other wind-family items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive listing of wind-instrument types and components (e.g., 'REEDS FOR MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS'), for classifying inventions in wind-instrument manufacture or parts.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 17-03 - stringed instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Stringed instruments and parts: banjos, bows, chin rests (violin-), double bass, dulcimers, guitars, harps, mandolins, musical instruments (stringed-), pegs and tuning pegs, violin chin rests, violins, violoncellos, zithers, tuning pegs and accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes both whole instruments and fine parts (pegs, tuning mechanisms), useful for mechanical or acoustical innovations for stringed instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLASS 17-04 - percussion instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Percussion family: bells (small and globular), castanets, chimes, cymbals, drumsticks (crum sticks / bass -), drums (big drums), gongs, and other percussive instruments and related items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists specific percussion instruments and accessories; use for classifying percussion-instrument related mechanical or structural improvements.
